svg.aria-label: BCBC 2024 Article 9.10.2.4 Buildings Containing More Than One Major Occupancy
svg.title: BCBC 2024 · 9.10.2.4 Buildings Containing More Than One Major Occupancy
svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.10 FIRE PROTECTION
Buildings Containing More Than One Major Occupancy

g.text: One Group D suite: 10% of the floor area of the storey
Two Group D suites: 20% in aggregate
Group F, Division 2 suite: 10% of the floor area

svg.text: In a building containing more than one major
occupancy, where the aggregate area of all
major occupancies in a particular group or
division does not exceed 10% of the floor area
on the storey on which they are located, they
need not be considered as major occupancies
for the purposes of Articles 9.10.8.1. and
Provided they are not classified as Group F,
Drawn: one storey in 10 equal bays, so each bay is 10% of its floor area. Walls cut low.
